baseline.authority: Current local homepage after approved arrow removal and shared chrome fixes; final cascade is authoritative

cssVariables.--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

sectionEditorial.note: Inventory only: use the exact section/viewport declarations in homepage-baseline.json. No universal tablet scale.

sectionLarge.note: Per-section scales are distinct. Apply exact scoped custom properties/media conditions in homepage-baseline.json; services line-height is 1.12.

hero.note: Hero has its own responsive scale and approved italic yellow accent.

compatibilityAliases.fontSerif: --font-serif resolves to Overused Grotesk; it is not permission to add a serif family.

layout.note: Approved inventory, not a mandatory fixed-step grid. Existing component geometry remains authoritative.

scopedBreakpointExceptions.note: Preserve exact component conditions; do not normalize these to the general layout breakpoints.

badge.icon: None: removed decorative corner/pixel arrows stay removed
badge.note: Shared white surface, inset, border, shadow and responsive type across section labels. About retains approved weight 500. Reviewed in Paper desktop/mobile 13 October 2026.

exceptions.policyHero: Use the current privacy.css blue composition
exceptions.contactDialog: Scoped existing dialog design; never use it as a reference for ordinary pages

footer.typography: Manrope 14px/1.6 navigation, locations and utility; Overused500 invitation and natural-proportion Overused700 wordmark. Text remains live.

contactClose.reason: Keep close target above animated brand row, including mobile

motion.note: Inventory includes defined reveal effects. Effective overrides can disable them; do not reactivate dormant effects. Navbar geometry is synchronized without transitions during initial render, font settlement, pageshow and resize; normal tab motion is enabled only after the pill has been measured.

status.observerThresholdMeaning: Observer notification thresholds; existing callbacks use isIntersecting, not a strict intersectionRatio guard.
status.achievementHoverLimitation: Pointer entry clears the timer, but clicking or visibility callbacks may reschedule while hovered; this extraction does not change that behavior.
status.reducedMotionLimitation: Client-logo hover scale remains present with globally shortened transitions. Do not claim every hover transform is removed.

provenance.palette: dist/styles.css theme layer; dist/blitz.css font aliases; dist/refinements.css effective font roles
provenance.responsiveGeometry: Source-scoped custom properties in design/homepage-baseline.json; apply media conditions and CSS order before choosing a value
provenance.footerAndPolicies: Cobalt night-garden footer, refined13 October2026 after user spacing/navigation feedback; desktop/mobile original imagegen masters, live fonts, shared navigation rules and anchored office lanes. Footer CSS remains last.
provenance.motion: dist/app.js, dist/footer.js, dist/case-study-motion.js, dist/site-ui.js and source CSS

scopeExport.note: Generated custom-property profiles only. Preserve selectors, source order and media conditions; not a standalone component stylesheet. Legacy --t-* export is restricted to badge variables because the old carousel is dormant. Runtime scatter progress is not exported.
